therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: amyloid plaque detection via PET imaging
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients with Normal Pressure Hydrocephalus undergoing shunt placement
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Correlation coefficient (SUVR) between PET brain uptake at biopsy site and immunohistochemical amyloid levels, using cerebellum as reference region

results.target_engagement_evidence: SUVR values correlated with immunohistochemical amyloid estimates; composite region correlation r=0.81
biomarker_changes: SUVR (CER reference): biopsy site r=0.64, contralateral r=0.69, composite r=0.81
SUVR (Pons reference): biopsy site r=0.60, contralateral r=0.63, composite r=0.76
subgroup_findings: Composite region showed highest correlation with amyloid IHC (r=0.81 CER reference, r=0.76 Pons reference)
Contralateral to biopsy site showed intermediate correlation (r=0.69 CER, r=0.63 Pons)
Biopsy site showed lowest correlation (r=0.64 CER, r=0.60 Pons)

context.duration: Single imaging session post injection; trial ran March 2010 to April 2011
context.investigator_commentary: Trial was terminated due to 'Changed focus of the program' per sponsor (GE Healthcare).
